groups.title: Day trading on 1- to 15-minute candles
groups.question: Can intraday candle setups at support and resistance make a daily profit on BTC, ETH and other major coins, after fees?
groups.answer: No. About 26,000 backtests of fifteen well-known setups found one variant that passed selection and a held-out month, and it lost money on five other coins and on the three months before. On 1- to 15-minute stops, fees alone cost 0.3R to 1.4R a trade, more than any candle pattern earned.

groups.title: Monthly profit from swing and trend trading
groups.question: With $500 to $1,000, trading most days but judged by the month, which strategies on Binance coins actually made money, and how much?
groups.answer: Trend following on 4-hour candles did. Chosen on 2023 to 2025, the survivors made money in the year to September 2026 while buying and holding the same coins lost 41%, and every one of them also made money, unchanged, on 2020 to 2023. The best rule for a futures account averaged about +2.5% of the account a month, with 40 of 73 months profitable and a largest fall of about 18%. Long-only rules on spot earned less and waited longer to recover. Losing months are common, buying and holding beat every rule in the bull years, and the funding-rate carry trade earned a steadier 3% a year recently.

groups.title: Beyond one strategy: how quants scale up
groups.question: How do algorithmic traders make much more, which other instruments or signals help, and what can a lone trader running a bot on Binance realistically do?
groups.answer: Most of the big daily profits in crypto come from businesses a lone trader can't copy: market making with fee rebates, speed arbitrage between exchanges, and funding and basis trades run with millions and the lowest fee tiers. What a single account can use is the professional method: several uncorrelated edges, sized together. Of the new ideas tested on six years of data, rotating into the five strongest of 43 coins each week (only while BTC is above its 100-day average) held up out of sample; sentiment added little beyond a trend filter; time-of-day and pairs trading didn't survive costs. Combining the Study 2 trend rule with coin rotation roughly doubled the average month at a similar worst fall, about +4% a month with a largest fall of about 20% over six years, and about +3% a month in the two held-out years. That is still a risky strategy with long flat and losing stretches, not a daily income.

picks.title: For a futures account: long and short
picks.why: Also earns in falling markets by going short, which is why it held up in the year the market fell. Needs a futures account; use 1x, no leverage.
picks.rule: On the 4-hour chart of each coin, go long when SuperTrend (10 candles, multiplier 3) flips up and short when it flips down. Close on the opposite flip, or if price moves 2 ATR against you.

picks.title: For a spot account: long only
picks.why: Needs no futures account and no borrowing, so it works on Binance spot with any amount above the $5 minimum order. Weaker than the futures pick: it can't earn in falling markets.
picks.rule: On the 4-hour chart of each coin, buy when a candle closes above the upper Keltner channel (the 20-candle EMA plus 2 times the 10-candle ATR). Sell when a candle closes below the middle line, or if price falls 3 ATR below your entry.

pick_rule: Among the variants that survived 2.1 and 2.2, keep those that made money in all three periods and spent at most 18 months below their previous peak, then take the best ratio of average month to largest fall from a peak.

combo.rule: Each component is the pick of its own study: the Study 2 futures rule, and the rotation survivor with the best Sharpe before July 2024 among those that rebalance weekly. Weights are proportional to 1 / volatility of each component's monthly results before July 2024, then fixed.
combo.rotation_rule: Every Monday, rank the coins by their return over the last 30 days and put the rotation's share of the account equally into the top 5, but only while BTC closes above its 100-day average; otherwise hold cash. Spot, no leverage.
